name: Brad O'Neil

bio.statement: O'Neil's pamphlet statement lists his occupation as undersheriff of the Clackamas County Sheriff's Office.
O'Neil's pamphlet statement lists prior roles as patrol, investigations and search-and-rescue commander and K-9 sergeant.
bio.excerpt: Undersheriff; Patrol Commander; Investigations Commander; Search and Rescue Commander; K-9 Sergeant/Handler

bio.statement: O'Neil's pamphlet statement lists the FBI National Academy (2023), Clackamas and Portland community colleges, and Gladstone High School.
bio.excerpt: FBI National Academy Graduate (2023); Clackamas Community College; Portland Community College; Gladstone High School

bio.statement: OPB reports O'Neil has worked at the sheriff's office since 1999 and served the past two years as undersheriff.
bio.excerpt: O’Neil has worked at the sheriff’s office since 1999, serving the past two years as an undersheriff.

positions.statement: In his voters' pamphlet statement, O'Neil says he would improve response times, investigations, jail operations and frontline services.
positions.excerpt: Strengthen public safety — Improve response times, investigations, jail operations, and frontline services

positions.statement: O'Neil's pamphlet statement says he would protect the community while using public resources responsibly.
positions.excerpt: Safeguard taxpayer dollars — Protect our community while using public resources responsibly.

positions.statement: O'Neil's pamphlet statement says he would set expectations, measure results and communicate openly.
positions.excerpt: Strengthen accountability and transparency — Set expectations, measure results, communicate openly

positions.statement: In an October 2026 OPB article, O'Neil says voters need to be informed about the sheriff's levy and why passing it matters to them.
positions.excerpt: "We have to inform the voters on what this levy is about and why it’s important to them to get it passed," O’Neil said.

positions.statement: OPB reports O'Neil said that as sheriff he would build a solid connection with the board of commissioners.
positions.excerpt: As sheriff, O’Neil said he would take the time to build a solid connection with the board of commissioners

verification_summary.balance_notes: Sheriff race: O'Neil has 9 items (6 T1 pamphlet, 3 T3 OPB 2026-10-09) and Rhodes has 10 (7 T1, 3 T3, same OPB article). The two are comparable, and both had the same OPB article mined. Neither file uses its campaign site (oneilforsheriff.com and electsheriffrhodes.com are both printed in the pamphlet), so that omission is symmetric. The spot-search found nothing missed beyond KPTV/OPB coverage of Brandenburg's resignation, which has no candidate positions.
